what: self-build 16:17 (tree a674d33407dd2143): stdx (tempfile.rs:43, :67) and rustc_abi (layout/coroutine.rs:107, :137, :191) fail with "blaze cannot evaluate static META: NotSupported(file!() evaluated with no source names ... (name_sources))" (tracing callsite statics). Nothing in the v2 build calls hir_ty_codegen::name_sources (= hir_ty_mir::mir::location::name_sources) any more: v1 blaze-engine lib.rs called it after loading each workspace and was dropped in 5d69a67f48 (the 10-30 reboot checkpoint). The v2 daemon has to call it on its database once the files are loaded and before codegen (blaze-cargo serve, where serve/unit/codegen.rs:492 builds HirFrontend), with the old rule: key = the loaded checkout roots joined by NUL, innermost first; name = the library file path as is for toolchain library files, else the path relative to the innermost checkout root containing it, else the absolute path. Same key again is a no-op, so calling it every load is cheap. The test in hir-ty-mir tests/mir/source_names.rs pins the evaluator side; please add one that a crate with a tracing-style static holding file!() builds. Context: git show 5d69a67f48 -- crates/blaze-engine/src/lib.rs | rg -n name_sources -A20.
